category.quote: Financial assistance of up to ₹10,000 is provided to street vendors to help them restart and expand their businesses.

occupation.quote: Street vendors in possession of Certificate of Vending / Identity Card issued by Urban Local Bodies (ULBs).

gate_notes: Requires Certificate of Vending / Identity Card or Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from ULB / Town Vending Committee (TVC)
